fusions.name: Stooping Dive
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Strikes a target up to 8 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full range.

fusions.name: Scattered Quills
fusions.desc: Looses 3 quills at once that fly up to 10 tiles, each dealing 3 damage, with a 15% chance per hit to leave the target [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: High Vantage
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Circling Angle
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
